newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telefonica del Peru.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telefonica del Peru.

text.p: -- Morgan Stanley said it initiated coverage of Telefonica del Peru SA with a neutral rating.
-- The analyst was not immediately available for comment.
-- Shares were down 1/8 on the NYSE.

-- Analyst Luiz Carvalho said in a research note that the neutral rating was due to the fact that "the company's attractive growth prospects and good regulatory conditions are largely incorporated in the stock price at this point."

-- He also said, "In spite of the company's very impressive achievements since its privatization, and the strong stock performance during the global offer earlier this year, we believe that the stock has lost some momentum."
